title: Setup copy: ADR numbers and schema vocabulary leave the object, type and navigation descriptions admins read
body:
## Source

Read in the console's Setup app on 2026-10-16 (objectui main `8415d9f11`, objectstack `18.0.0-next.1` serving HotCRM). Descriptions an administrator sees under a page title:

- Business Units: "Canonical Business Unit tree — hierarchical org/data-partition node (company / division / department / region / office). ADR-0057 D2." (`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-business-unit.object.ts`)
- Capability: "Package-declared authorization capability — the DEFINITION side of ADR-0066 D1 (grants live on permission sets; requirements on resources)" (the spec's type description, surfaced through `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/en.metadata-forms.generated.ts`)
- Permission Set `organization_admin_no_bypass`: "… (ADR-0105 D4 / finding F2) …"
- Notification Events: "Notification events — one row per emit() (ADR-0030 Layer 2 ingress)" (`packages/platform-objects/src/audit/sys-notification.object.ts`)
- Notification Preferences: "Per-user × topic × channel notification toggle (mute/allow), with admin-global defaults." (`packages/services/service-messaging/src/objects/notification-preference.object.ts`)
- Record Shares: "Per-record sharing grant — extends OWD with explicit access"; Approval Delegations: "Self-service out-of-office rule: route this user's approver slots to a delegate within a time window."; Installed Apps: "Note: The kernel API is additive only — uninstall removes the on-disk manifest so the package won't load on next boot…".

These strings are the `description` / `label` fields of platform objects, spec types and Setup navigation entries, so they reach every locale through the generated translations.

## Target

1. Every description an admin reads in Setup is one sentence in the user's words: what the records are and what you do here. ADR numbers, "D2 / D4 / finding F2", "Layer 2 ingress", "emit()", "kernel API", "additive only", "data-partition node" move to the object's docblock or to a `docs` link field the console can render as "Learn more".
2. The sentences for the objects above, as a starting point: Business Units "Your company structure — divisions, departments, regions and offices — used to scope data and reports."; Capability "What a permission set may grant beyond object access: Setup, Studio, user management and the like."; Notification Events "Every notification the platform sent, one row per event."; Notification Preferences "Which topics and channels each user receives; admins set the defaults."; Record Shares "Records shared beyond their owner, one row per grant."; Approval Delegations "Route your approvals to someone else while you are away."
3. The generated translation files regenerate from the sources; the zh-CN and ja-JP files follow.

## File surface

`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/*.object.ts`, `packages/platform-objects/src/audit/*.object.ts`, `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup.app.ts` and `setup-nav.contributions.ts` (nav descriptions), `packages/services/service-messaging/src/objects/*.object.ts`, the spec type descriptions in `packages/spec` that the metadata-forms translations are generated from, the generated translation files. This crosses `domain:engine`, `domain:services` and `domain:spec`: the triage seat names the lane or splits the card (`pm:retriage`).

## Acceptance

1. A test (or a lint over the object and app sources) asserts no `description` or nav `label` under Setup contains `ADR-`, `D\d\b`, `finding F`, `emit()` or `kernel`.
2. The console's Setup pages, re-read after the change, show the new sentences (the epic PM reads them).
3. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`, the translation generation gate and `pnpm check:i18n` green.

## Constraints

- Docblocks and ADR links in code stay; only user-facing strings move.

## Evidence

Screenshots on the temporary branch `claude/console-home-login-design-20261016` of objectstack-ai/objectui (commit `01244b886`, never merged): [setup-positions-metadata-page.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/01244b886/docs/design/setup-review-2026-10-16/setup-positions-metadata-page.png?raw=true) · [setup-capability-metadata-page-small.jpg](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/01244b886/docs/design/setup-review-2026-10-16/setup-capability-metadata-page-small.jpg?raw=true).

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-16 second review pass: objectui main `8415d9f11`, HotCRM `63db83e2`, the vite console on :5180 against `objectstack serve --dev` on :4001, the Studio pillars and all 43 Setup pages walked in the maintainer's browser pane at 1024 × 768 (en) with a 1280 × 900 re-check (zh). The maintainer asked for every finding to be filed, verbatim: 「全部立卡」.</sub>
